tools.name: reservoprix_create_offer_link
tools.description: Prepare a sealed-offer link (a "Make an offer" link and button for a listing) for something the user sells. Returns a confirm_url: the seller opens it, signs in with Google and confirms — only then is the link live. Never returns or needs a credential.

tools.name: reservoprix_get_offer_link
tools.description: The public status of a reservoPrix offer link: what is offered, open or closed, until when, and the link a buyer opens to make an offer. Accepts the code or the whole https://reservoprix.com/o/<code> link.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "reservoprix_get_offer_link" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
